主要内容: The document titled '6-K' is a report filed by the Royal Bank of Canada with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on March 1, 2012. It includes the First Quarter 2012 Earnings Release, a Report to Shareholders, and other financial disclosures. The report is incorporated by reference into several registration statements, including Form F-3 and multiple Form S-8 filings. The document is signed by Janice R. Fukakusa, who holds the title of Chief Administrative Officer and Chief Financial Officer. The report provides insights into the bank's financial performance and strategic direction for the first quarter of 2012.
